name: Marketing site
purpose: Hero, pricing cards, and FAQ accordion for a marketing landing fragment.
scenarios: Introduce a product with a hero call to action
Expand FAQ answers in an accordion

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onCta.description: Called when a hero or plan call to action is activated.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: Hero, pricing, and FAQ are visible.

antiPatterns: Do not restyle this block with raw left/right CSS.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Tab reaches CTAs and FAQ triggers
Enter or Space expands a FAQ item
a11y.focus: Actions stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Pricing and FAQ sections have headings; accordion triggers name the question.

responsive.strategy: Pricing uses @container with the tablet rem token; no viewport media queries.

breakpoints.medium: Plans become three columns at 48rem container inline-size.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
